title: Level 4 Lab: Deterministic Topic Graph & Closed-List Entity Validation
summary: Author a Copilot Studio Topic using Closed List entities, numeric bounds checks, and Power Fx expressions instead of fragile prompt-only logic.
requires: Copilot Studio Dev Sandbox.
features: Enforces deterministic branching and type-safe slot filling.
roles: Replace brittle prompt parsing with strongly typed Topic variables.
Evaluate business thresholds in Power Fx Condition nodes.
Prevent invalid enum or negative numeric inputs.
prompt: Author a Copilot Studio Topic with Closed List entity validation for Facility (Garage 2, Lot B, Lot D Overflow), numeric validation for Count (>0), and a Power Fx condition routing Count > 40 to Lot D Overflow [Rule EV-01].

steps.title: Define Closed List Entity
steps.text: In Copilot Studio -> Entities -> New entity -> Closed list, create 'FacilityList' with items Garage 2, Lot B, and Lot D Overflow (plus synonyms).
steps.help: Closed lists automatically handle synonyms and reprompt on invalid entries.

steps.title: Build Question nodes with validation
steps.text: Add Question nodes bound to FacilityList and Number (with condition Topic.Count > 0).
steps.help: Rejects zero or negative counts deterministically.

steps.title: Write Power Fx routing condition
steps.text: Add Condition node: `Topic.Count > 40` -> override facility variable to 'Lot D Overflow [Rule EV-01]' and compute `Topic.TotalCost = Topic.Count * 8`.
steps.help: Power Fx guarantees 100% exact arithmetic.

steps.title: Test invalid enum and boundary values
steps.text: Test Count = -5 (reprompts), Count = 40 (stays in requested lot), and Count = 41 (routes to Lot D Overflow, Cost = $328).
steps.help: Boundary verification at 40 vs. 41 confirms exact threshold logic.

check: Reprompts on negative count and normalizes synonyms via Closed List entity.
Routes Count=41 to Lot D Overflow with exact Power Fx cost $328.
sources: Microsoft · Add actions and connectors in Copilot Studio
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/advanced-plugin-actions

title: Level 4 Lab: Adaptive Card Preview & Human-in-the-Loop Write Action

roles: Build interactive Adaptive Card confirmation UIs in Copilot Studio.
Bind write actions via parameterized Connection References.
Enforce Rule GOV-05 human-in-the-loop safety.
prompt: Render an Adaptive Card displaying Department, EventDate, Count, AssignedLot, and TotalCost with Confirm / Cancel submit actions. Invoke the Excel Online 'Add a row into a table' action ONLY when Confirm is clicked.

steps.title: Configure Adaptive Card node
steps.text: Add an Ask with Adaptive Card node binding Topic variables into a clean FactSet with Action.Submit buttons ('Confirm' and 'Cancel').
steps.help: Adaptive Cards give users a clear visual diff before mutating production records.

steps.title: Wire Action via Connection Reference
steps.text: On the Confirm branch, add Excel Online (Business) -> Add a row into a table using a Solution Connection Reference.
steps.help: Connection references decouple dev credentials from prod deployments.

steps.title: Enable Action Confirmation property
steps.text: Verify user confirmation is enabled on the connector action per [Rule GOV-05].
steps.help: Defense-in-depth against unintended writes.

steps.title: Test Confirm vs. Cancel paths
steps.text: Test Cancel (verify zero rows written) and Confirm (verify exactly 1 row appended with Status='Pending Review').
steps.help: Inspect the Excel table and Copilot Studio variable watch pane.

check: Adaptive Card renders accurate FactSet values.
Cancel writes 0 rows; Confirm appends 1 row via Connection Reference.

steps.title: Create an Unmanaged Solution in Dev
steps.text: Open Solutions in Copilot Studio -> New solution -> name it 'OpsCopilotAgents' with a custom publisher prefix.

steps.title: Define Environment Variables

steps.title: Bind variables inside Topic actions

steps.title: Verify Solution Checker
steps.text: Run Solution Checker and confirm zero missing dependencies.

title: Level 4 Lab: Idempotent Intake With Duplicate Key Detection
summary: Prevent double-submitted forms or retried chat turns from creating duplicate rows by querying existing RequestIDs before inserting.
requires: Copilot Studio + Excel Online / SharePoint List with RequestID key column.
features: Implements check-before-insert idempotency in low-code agent actions.
roles: Prevent duplicate records when users double-click Submit or retry a timed-out turn.
Implement lookup-before-insert patterns in Copilot Studio.
Maintain clean primary keys in team trackers.
prompt: Before calling 'Add a row', query existing rows matching RequestID. If RequestID already exists with identical fields, return 'Already logged (Idempotent Reuse)' without inserting; if RequestID exists with conflicting fields, flag 'Conflict—Human Review Required'.

steps.title: Add 'List rows present in a table' lookup
steps.text: Prior to the insert action, query the tracker table filtered by `RequestID eq '{Topic.RequestID}'`.
steps.help: Read-before-write prevents duplicate rows on retries.

steps.title: Branch on row count
steps.text: Add Condition: `length(body('List_rows')?['value']) == 0` -> proceed to Insert; else compare existing row fields.
steps.help: Distinguishes benign retries from conflicting edits.

steps.title: Test benign retry (same RequestID, same data)
steps.text: Submit REQ-901 twice with identical data and verify only 1 row exists in the table.
steps.help: Second run should emit 'Already logged' receipt.

steps.title: Test conflicting update (same RequestID, changed guest count)
steps.text: Submit REQ-901 with a different GuestCount and verify it halts with 'Conflict—Human Review Required' without overwriting.
steps.help: Protects data integrity.

check: Benign retry reuses existing row without duplicating.
Conflicting payload flags conflict without silent overwrite.
sources: Microsoft · Add actions and connectors in Copilot Studio
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/advanced-plugin-actions

title: Level 5 Lab: Filtered Event Trigger & Teams Adaptive Card Escalation

Prevent Teams notification fatigue via strict filter conditions.
Audit autonomous runs in Copilot Studio Activity logs.
prompt: Add an autonomous trigger ('When an item is created') on the tracker. Filter for `GuestCount > 40` OR `ADA_Impact == true`. Ground in the approved handbook to attach exact Rule IDs, and post an Adaptive Card alert to the private Ops-Alerts-Test Teams channel.

steps.title: Configure Trigger & Filter
steps.text: In Copilot Studio -> Overview -> Triggers, add 'When an item is created' and specify the threshold filter (`GuestCount > 40`).
steps.help: Filtering early minimizes unnecessary generative runs and ACU/message consumption.

steps.title: Ground trigger response in handbook
steps.text: Instruct the agent to cite [Rule EV-01] for >40 vehicles or [Rule SH-03] for ADA lift outages inside the Teams card.
steps.help: Enriches raw row events with actionable policy context.

steps.title: Post to isolated test channel
steps.text: Wire the Teams connector to a private test channel and verify DLP compliance (both SharePoint and Teams are Business connectors).
steps.help: Never point sandbox triggers at production channels.

steps.title: Verify Activity trace on below-threshold vs. above-threshold rows
steps.text: Insert a 15-guest row (filtered/no post) and a 60-guest row (posts Teams card). Inspect Activity run history.
steps.help: Activity logs provide step-by-step execution telemetry.

check: 15-guest row produces zero Teams alerts.
60-guest row posts rule-cited Teams card and records clean Activity trace.

title: Level 5 Capstone: Multi-Agent Enterprise Architecture & Orchestration
summary: Architect a parent Operations Orchestrator in Copilot Studio delegating across three modular specialist agents (Policy RAG, CSV/Telemetry Analyst, and Governed Action Intake).
requires: Copilot Studio Dev/UAT environment + 3 modular child agents.
features: Applies microservices-style separation of concerns to multi-agent orchestration.
roles: Decompose complex business domains into small, high-precision specialist agents.
Configure generative orchestration descriptions for accurate parent-to-child routing.

prompt: Configure a parent Orchestrator Agent delegating to: (1) Policy Specialist (closed-corpus SharePoint RAG), (2) Telemetry & Log Analyst (CodeInterpreter CSV diagnostics), and (3) Governed Intake Specialist (Adaptive Card + confirmed Excel write). Verify routing and unified synthesis.

steps.title: Audit child agent boundaries
steps.text: Verify each child agent has <=5 knowledge URLs, WebSearch=Off, and a crisp, non-overlapping description specifying inputs and outputs.

steps.code: Compound test: 'Check Rule EV-01 overflow threshold, inspect open maintenance tickets for BUS-12, and state our ADA backup SLA [Rule SH-03].'

steps.title: Verify trace & package in Solution
steps.text: Inspect the Activity trace for clean child handoffs, confirm exact Rule IDs in the synthesized reply, and add the parent + child agents to your Managed Solution.
steps.help: Capstone complete—ready for enterprise governance sign-off!

check: Activity trace confirms accurate routing across specialist agents.
